tagline: A yellow square, a brick cave, and your best run inside the file.
description:
The cave is in the file. There is no account and no install — open it on a plane, on a phone, on a computer.

Run, jump, take the gold, bounce on the grey blocks. Hit one from the side and you start over; gold you already took stays taken. When the eight gold bricks and the eight grey ones are gone, the cave is cleared.

On a phone the buttons sit under your thumbs — left, right, jump. On a computer it is the arrows or WASD, and space or up to jump. Close it, come back: your best gold count is still there, inside the file.

An unofficial port of Tiny Platformer by Jake Gordon, MIT-licensed. This copy adds the phone buttons, follows you with the camera, and keeps the best run in the file.
